d:
Relive Red Eyes by Karan Aujla ft. Gurlej Akhtar, now in stunning 8K Karan Aujla wrote, composed and sang it, Proof made the beat, and Gurlej Akhtar's powerful female vocals complete it. One of the most loved Punjabi duets, back in sharper detail than ever.
Featuring Ginni Kapoor, with story, screenplay and direction by Jeona & Jogi.
Song Credits
Song: Red Eyes
Singer, Lyrics & Composer: Karan Aujla
Female Vocal: Gurlej Akhtar
Music: Proof
Mix Master: Dense
